newsitem.title: UK: No decision on repairing VLCC Once after collision.
newsitem.headline: No decision on repairing VLCC Once after collision.

text.p: The very large crude carrier (VLCC) Once which was in collision with the bulk carrier Amber in the Mediterranean sustained serious damage to its hull and is currently anchored off Fos, an official for the tanker's managers said on Friday.
The 269,919 dwt, Kerguelen Islands-flagged Once was not carrying crude when the collision occurred on Tuesday. No decision has yet been made on repairing the vessel, she added.
Lloyd's Casualty said the 76,583 dwt, Singapore-flagged Amber had also suffered quite serious damage.
